decisions_log.decision: Used app/not-found.tsx (Next.js App Router built-in) for custom 404 handling.
decisions_log.rationale: This is the idiomatic Next.js App Router pattern; the framework automatically serves this file for any unmatched route without any extra configuration.

decisions_log.decision: Mirrored the app/page.tsx outer/inner div structure (bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-black outer, bg-white dark:bg-black inner) on the 404 page.
decisions_log.rationale: Ensures visual continuity with the rest of the site and reuses existing Tailwind tokens as required by the SWE constraint.

decisions_log.decision: Used an inline SVG alert/info circle icon (aria-hidden) as the subtle graphic for the error state.
decisions_log.rationale: No new assets or dependencies are needed; the icon is decorative and correctly hidden from assistive technology with aria-hidden='true'.

decisions_log.decision: Used next/link for the 'Return to Home' button to ensure client-side navigation.
decisions_log.rationale: Consistent with Next.js best practices for internal navigation and satisfies AC2.

deferred_questions.question: The visual style of the 'subtle icon or graphic' was listed as a deferred decision in the sketch. An inline SVG alert circle was chosen as the simplest no-new-assets approach — confirm or replace with a preferred icon.

files_changed.summary: Custom 404 page using Next.js App Router not-found convention. Displays the required error message, a 'Return to Home' link to '/', an aria-hidden decorative SVG alert icon, and mirrors the page.tsx outer/inner layout with zinc colour tokens for light/dark theme support.
Jest + React Testing Library tests covering the custom 404 page across all four acceptance criteria.

self_assessment.notes: All 31 tests pass (npm test), lint is clean (npm run lint), and TypeScript type-check passes (tsc --noEmit). The new file is confined to app/not-found.tsx; app/layout.tsx and app/page.tsx were not modified. Tailwind zinc colour tokens from page.tsx were reused throughout. The 'Return to Home' link uses next/link and href='/'. The decorative SVG carries aria-hidden='true'. Dark-mode classes are applied via Tailwind's dark: variant, consistent with the site's ThemeProvider pattern. AC4 (dark theme) is covered structurally by the presence of the correct dark: Tailwind classes; runtime dark-mode rendering is exercised by the ThemeProvider tests already in the suite.
